dialogues.speaker: Kanra
dialogues.text: Ah, I'm talking about my lover. He is now serving as a soldier in Tatarasuna.

dialogues.speaker: Kanra
dialogues.text: I've written letters to him before, asking if he was doing well... But somehow none of these letters got a reply.

dialogues.speaker: Kanra
dialogues.text: I don't really have any other way to contact him, so I can only pray for him here. I hope that the archon will bless him and keep him safe...
